items.title: Require sessionSource host-adapter in deriveRoleProvenance
items.context: topology-critic-receipt.ts deriveRoleProvenance accepts sessionId but never checks its provenance. Add a sessionSource parameter and refuse anything other than host-adapter. explicit-env is whatever was put in LATTICE_SESSION_ID and derived-ppid is a process-tree hash; neither is evidence of an independent actor. Both call sites are in packages/main/src/handlers/proofstory.ts at lines 550 and 565 (note a distinct packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts also exists), and both can read getSessionIdentity().sessionSource.
items.userSees: topology_critic_receipt_set from a session whose id came from LATTICE_SESSION_ID fails with: role eligibility failed: lattice-review-topology-critic must sign from a host-adapter session, received "explicit-env".

happy.desc: A host-adapter session reaches deriveRoleProvenance and signing proceeds to the verdict branch

edge.desc: Both call sites are bound, not just the critic: the scope-plan exclusion approver at proofstory.ts:550 is refused for a forgeable session too

adversarial.desc: An explicit-env session supplied via LATTICE_SESSION_ID is refused before any verdict branch runs, so neither pass nor request_changes can be signed under a session the implementer chose

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke drives topology_critic_receipt_set through the real production CLI using an adapter-derived critic session; it reaches deriveRoleProvenance, clears the new host-adapter source gate, and completes signing to the verdict.

items.title: Migrate test session setup from LATTICE_SESSION_ID to adapter env
items.context: LATTICE_SESSION_ID appears on 167 lines (170 total occurrences; 3 lines carry it twice) across 29 files under packages/main/src/tasks. Both counts are correct under different methodologies: grep -c counts lines, grep -o counts occurrences. An earlier figure of 208/30 in this story was simply wrong, because the glob matched only the top level instead of recursing. LATTICE_SESSION_ID resolves to explicit-env and would be refused by CHK-001. Replace with LATTICE_OWNER_SESSION_ADAPTER_PROVIDER plus TASK plus AGENT so the adapter derives the session the way a real host does. The derived id depends on projectRoot, so fixtures that compare hardcoded ids such as sess-critic must resolve them through deriveAdapterOwnerSessionId rather than matching the literal.

items.title: Prove the guard bites under mutation
items.context: Assert that explicit-env, derived-ppid and generated-token are each refused for a critic receipt, and that a genuine host-adapter session is still accepted. Without a mutation-style negative test this repeats finding B-3f3d F-115, where a security-relevant change shipped with no coverage at all.
items.userSees: proofstory-topology-critic-smoke reports PASS, and reverting the CHK-001 guard makes it fail with an assertion naming the forgeable session source.

adversarial.desc: Reverting the CHK-001 guard makes the smoke test fail with an assertion naming the forgeable session source, proving the test bites rather than passing vacuously

verificationEvidence.note: The test bites rather than passing vacuously: removing the guard makes it fail, restoring the guard makes it pass. Attested rather than pinned because the proof is a multi-step edit-build-revert cycle.
verificationEvidence.nonMechanicalReason: A mutation proof cannot be expressed as one pinned command, because it requires editing source, rebuilding, observing FAILURE, reverting, rebuilding and observing PASS. I performed that sequence directly in this session: widening SIGNABLE_SESSION_SOURCES at topology-critic-receipt.ts:150 to include explicit-env and derived-ppid, then rebuilding, made this smoke exit non-zero; restoring the original two-element set and rebuilding made it exit 0 again. The working tree is byte-identical to HEAD afterwards (git diff --stat empty), so no mutation residue shipped. This is an audited attestation of a manual mutation cycle, not a tool-executed receipt.

items.title: Prove a genuine dispatched critic can complete receipt signing end to end
items.context: INIT-002: CHK-001 and CHK-003 only prove forged sessions are refused. Neither proves the positive case, which is the reason the story exists: BUG-CRITIC-DISPATCH-PROVENANCE-UNSATISFIABLE means no correctly sandboxed critic could sign at all. The 9f9f53a514 behaviour referenced here is the fix committed during B-3f3d, which moved the acceptance-basis requirement off an unconditional throw and onto the pass branch only, so a critic can record request_changes over a stale basis while pass still requires a verified one. Drive the full path with a real host-adapter session: dispatch the critic, review_run_start, then topology_critic_receipt_set for both verdicts. request_changes must succeed on a stale basis and pass must still be refused while the basis is stale. Without this the story could ship a guard that blocks everything including legitimate critics.
items.userSees: A critic dispatched through a host adapter records a receipt, and topology_critic_receipt_check reports the recorded verdict instead of no current registered dispatch provenance.

happy.desc: A genuinely dispatched critic that did not receive its session id from the implementer records request_changes successfully

edge.desc: If the real host does not supply provider plus task plus agent, the resulting failure blocks the story rather than being worked around

adversarial.desc: pass is still refused while the acceptance basis is stale, so the 9f9f53a514 asymmetry survives this change

verificationEvidence.note: An independently dispatched topology critic whose session the host adapter derived (sess-966420819fb1e7eb71ae8e7557fc2a0e, host-adapter, provider=claude-code) signed a request_changes receipt successfully. Its session was distinct from the implementer owner session sess-bb4571e896a18423ba2230f65e1f00a8 and from a prior critic session sess-90160e11, and it chose its own task label rather than receiving one from the implementer. The signed receipt records independence as agent true, session true, dispatch true, businessCommitAuthor true. This rules out decision_set preMortem 1, that the guard would block every critic including legitimate ones.

pass was REFUSED with: critic cannot override partial discovery. The refusing condition was basisStatus partial, and the critic verified the basis is fresh (receipt headHash and storyFilesHash match current HEAD), so this is a completeness refusal rather than a staleness refusal. That is a distinct but analogous asymmetry to the one commit 9f9f53a514 introduced: request_changes tolerates an incomplete or stale basis while pass requires a complete and current one. The asymmetry is intact and still biting after the CHK-001 session-source guard landed. Note the stale-basis variant specifically was NOT exercised in this run; only the partial-basis variant was.

The host adapter did supply provider plus task plus agent, and the derived session resolved to host-adapter rather than falling back to derived-ppid, so the failure mode this intent guards against did not occur. review_run_start itself refused only because it is REVIEW-phase-only while the story is in DEV, which is a phase gate rather than an identity failure; the critic independently corroborated this by noting that lattice-review-topology-critic is not even an enumerated --lane value for that command.

items.title: Accept generated-token alongside host-adapter as a host-derived signing source
items.context: PLAN investigation found that generated-token passes the SAME provider plus task plus agent gate as host-adapter (owner-session-adapters.ts:160-173) and additionally requires a boundary token, so it is equally host-derived and equally unmintable by an implementer. decision_set option A therefore accepts both. CHK-003 context, frozen at INIT_CHECK, still lists generated-token among the sources to refuse; that wording was carried over from the over-strict B-3f3d prototype and is superseded by this item. The accepted set is host-adapter plus generated-token; the refused set is explicit-env plus derived-ppid. CHK-003 title, Prove the guard bites under mutation, remains accurate and is unaffected.
